title: Word Jobs: Nouns, Verbs, Adjectives, Adverbs
subject: language

sections.body: NOUNS name people, places or things: girl, city, pencil.
VERBS are action or being words: run, think, is.
ADJECTIVES describe nouns: a TALL tree. ADVERBS describe verbs, often ending in -ly: she ran QUICKLY.
TENSE shows time: I walk (present), I walked (past), I will walk (future).

quiz.q: In 'The happy dog barked loudly', which word is the adverb?
hints: Adverbs describe how an action is done.
Which word describes HOW the dog barked?
In 'She sang sweetly', 'sweetly' describes how she sang. Find the -ly word here.
quiz.explain: 'Loudly' describes how the dog barked, so it's the adverb.

quiz.q: Which sentence is in the PAST tense?
hints: 'I jumped' happened yesterday. Which verb here ends in -ed?
quiz.explain: 'Played' shows it already happened: past tense.
